baseline.quantile_method: R-7 linear interpolation at (n-1)*p after ascending sort

calibration.composition_constraints: EBS/early-bag share and flight-bank profile calibrate demand composition and time shape; they are not arbitrary scalar factors.
calibration.represented_bags_component_formula: (annual_passenger_movements / 365) * design_day_factor * departing_passenger_share * terminal_allocation_share * (local_departure_share * local_checked_bags_per_departing_passenger + transfer_departure_share * transfer_checked_bags_per_transfer_passenger) * represented_subsystem_share * (1 - parallel_diversion_share)

capacity_measurement_contract.mapf_agent_density_role: AUXILIARY_ONLY; active agents per node/edge may diagnose a specific closed-loop run but cannot calibrate airport demand.
required_capacity_metrics: source backlog and in-network backlog reported separately
completed bags per hour and unresolved-deadlock count
required_injection_metrics: bag injections per second and per 5/15/60-minute window
injections per physical source and business loading station

external_sources.claim: Official 2019 whole-airport passenger-throughput context; it does not identify the thesis airport or represented BHS share.

external_sources.authority: National Academies / Airport Cooperative Research Program
external_sources.claim: Design-day demand should use flight-by-flight schedules and airport-specific time-of-day/facility profiles; generic annual averages do not establish a baggage subsystem peak.
Official airport-planning guidance covers peak forecasting, design-day schedules, demand-capacity calculations, and BHS.
Capacity assessment should be subsystem-specific and driven by peak/design demand and the constraining process.

external_sources.authority: International Foundation for Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
external_sources.claim: MAPD models online exogenous task arrival; one-shot agent count is not a substitute for an arrival-process calibration.

external_sources.authority: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
external_sources.claim: Lifelong MAPF throughput is a time-based completed-goal measure; map-specific agent-density examples are auxiliary diagnostics.

future_generation_protocol.additional_bag_selection: deterministic stratified resampling with largest-remainder integer allocation and SHA-256 ordering within strata
future_generation_protocol.drift_threshold_policy: Thresholds must be declared before materialization and remain engineering tolerances, not evidence of real-world demand.
required_drift_audits: loading-station, unloader, source-node, goal-node, and OD shares
early-split share and EBS planned-dwell distribution
